lessons.title: Plan Migration & Backfill
lessons.summary: Plan reversible expand–migrate–contract steps with verification and rollback, and rehearse them.

definition.purpose: Move from today's data and structures to the new ones in steps that can each be undone.
definition.outcome: A rehearsed migration plan — expand, migrate, switch, contract — with a verification query and a rollback per step.
definition.jtbd: Help me change live data without turning a bug into an outage with no way back.

parallel: Rehearsal ∥ conflict resolution by data owners

cases.happyPath: Rehearsal matches expectations; owners resolve conflicts; cut-over goes site by site.
alternates: Greenfield data → no migration, only seed data
Large volume → batched, throttled backfill
edgeCases: Conflicting mappings across clerks' spreadsheets
Rollback window shorter than a business cycle
exceptions: Rehearsal fails → fix and rehearse again
failures: One-shot migration with no way back

policies: Cut-over follows the rollout by site
